verdict.rationale: A tax agency with electronic filing and XML submission schemas could plausibly publish a developer API reference, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a downloadable XML schema package, batch enrollment specs available by email request, and login-gated web applications. Nothing shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and probes for llms.txt and markdown docs returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
